title: Getting around the Chamonix Valley — Mont-Blanc Marathon
claims: The organiser says a dedicated, free transport plan of buses, shuttles and trains operates alongside the Chamonix Valley public network during the event.

To reach the starts of the 90 km, 42 km and 10 km outside public-transit hours, the organiser lists buses and trains from Vallorcine, from the Saint-Gervais-les-Bains–Le Fayet train station and from Les Houches.
Special buses, shuttles and trains also run for spectators along the 90 km, 42 km and 23 km courses.

The Chamonix Mobilité bus network has four main lines serving Les Houches, Chamonix, Argentière and Le Tour, and the Mont-Blanc Express runs from Saint-Gervais-les-Bains–Le Fayet to Martigny, with Vallorcine as the last French station.
The organiser offers a three-day Mont-Blanc Marathon bus pass for €7, valid on the whole Chamonix Valley bus network except night lines after 21:30.
The page mentions ATMB car-sharing car parks on the motorway network but publishes no race-day road-closure timetable or parking capacity.
